propositions: Project overlay entries can add trigger_tokens and applies_to globs to extend built-in overlay triggers (concurrency, performance, etc.) additively without replacing committed globs
trigger_tokens are literal substring matches on added and removed diff lines (case-sensitive, excluding file headers), and applies_to globs are unioned with committed globs via a new helper function
glob_triggered_overlays and content_triggered_overlays must consume project trigger extensions via project_trigger_extensions helper, with repo_root threaded from workflow_ops.overlay_union
Project trigger extensions are read directly from raw code_review entries, bypassing effective_routing merge semantics, to preserve additive union behavior instead of overlay-wins replace
Malformed project entries (non-list tokens, non-string token values, unknown overlay ids) are silently ignored without raising exceptions
With no project overlay present, both trigger functions produce identical results to current behavior, preserving backward compatibility
